items.title: Workflow SDK now writes over WebSockets on Vercel
items.summary: The  now sends event writes and stream writes to  over a WebSocket by default, replacing one HTTP request per write, or per write group for streams. No code change is needed beyond upgrading to  or later.Workflow SDKVercel Workflowsworkflow@5.2.0Once you deploy the upgrade, new runs use it. In-flight runs finish on the deployment they started on.Existing streaming code works as is. A step that writes a burst of chunks, like AI tokens, sends them over the WebSocket once it opens:In a  replaying an AI agent's token stream, v5.2.0, which writes streams over a WebSocket by default, delivered the full response 4.2× faster than v4.8.12, with no chunk delayed over a second.benchmarkEvery step start and completion is an event write, now sent over the WebSocket, so workflows with many steps make fewer HTTP requests. The added efficiency also improves performance and reduces costs. The queue handler opens the connection for every delivery. Read the  to get started. If you're on 4.x, start with the , since v5 is a major release.Vercel World documentationupgrade guideRead moreStreams keep pace with AI outputFewer HTTP requests for event writesGet started
